blocks.content: Two TypeScript programs: tsconfig.json compiles electron/ + shared/ to CommonJS in dist-electron (Node types, no Electron at type level in shared/); tsconfig.web.json typechecks web/src as a DOM/ESNext program with no emit (vite handles the build). vite.config.ts sets base './' — REQUIRED, absolute asset URLs blank-screen the packaged app — root web/, outDir dist-web, target chrome130, strictPort 5173 for dev.
The './' Vite base keeps renderer assets resolvable inside packaged apps.
